signals.summary: The U.S. National Park Service's 110th anniversary lands on Aug 25 with fee-free entry days, driving a burst of 'where to celebrate for free' and park-landscape coverage across national and local outlets.
signals.why_now: Multiple independent items in the last 48h tied to the Aug 25 anniversary and free-entry day: blog.google '110 years', Axios 'National parks turn 110', FOX 32 Chicago 'visit free Aug. 25', Travelers Today 'Free Entry Tuesday', Glacier NP celebration, WMTV 'Aug 25, 1916 law signed'.

signals.summary: 'Chaos gardening' - scattering mixed seeds for a wild, low-effort look - is being covered as a defining garden trend across a wide, independent spread of outlets, often paired with native-plant framing.
signals.why_now: Same named trend covered independently by Veranda, Tom's Guide, Vogue, NYT, Realtor.com, Hartford Courant and Axios (native-plant/Massachusetts angle). Evergreen seasonal gardening theme still generating fresh takes.

signals.summary: Gravel gardens and other 'low-effort but not boring' landscaping styles are being pushed as the 2026 backyard direction, alongside listicles of dated looks to drop.
signals.why_now: Independent coverage from Midwest Living (gravel gardening, 96h), Southern Living (dated yard trends; 'skip it' landscaping), Good Housekeeping (low-effort trend 'taking over backyards') and ELLE Decor (low-maintenance doesn't mean boring).

signals.summary: Kyrgyzstan's mountains are being framed as a viral 'TikTok trend without wifi' hiking destination, all dramatic alpine landscape and disconnection.
signals.why_now: Same destination story carried independently by AOL.com and The Independent within ~167h, part of a broader off-grid/disconnected-nature travel angle. Highly producible alpine imagery.

signals.summary: Trade coverage of the major 2026 flower shows (Philadelphia, RHS Chelsea) is surfacing forecast garden trends - naturalistic planting, color directions - as season-setting content.
signals.why_now: Independent trade outlets Greenhouse Grower (2026 Philadelphia Flower Show predictions) and Greenhouse Management ('6 trends from RHS Chelsea 2026') both distilling flower-show trends.

signals.summary: 'Phenology' - reading nature's seasonal calendar (bloom and leaf timing) to know when to plant - is recurring as an evergreen, almanac-style nature framing.
signals.why_now: Independent pieces from The Old Farmer's Almanac ('Planting by Nature: How Phenology Tells You When to Garden') and The Press Democrat ('Phenology: Reading nature's seasonal calendar').

signals.summary: 'Gorpcore' and 'cute hiking' styling - fashionable trail outfits, dad sneakers, barely-there hiking sandals - keeps generating fashion-desk coverage of the outdoors look.
signals.why_now: Independent coverage from E! News (gorpcore), CN Traveller (Dolomites it-girl packing list), Vogue (barely-there hiking sandal 'shoe of the summer'), USA TODAY and The Zoe Report. Skews to apparel and human wear rather than pure landscape.
